title: JuControler project x role Skill attachment
description: Read-only record of which Skills each project attaches to its PM, Worker, and QA roles. An attachment names a selection; it does not install, dispatch, or overwrite any Skill.

attachments.description: One entry per project and role; the (projectId, role) pair is unique across entries, and every project lists pm, worker, and qa.

projectId.description: Project Registry projectId the selection belongs to.

role.description: Harness role the Skills are selected for. Role is not Runtime.

skillIds.description: Explicitly selected Skill identifiers, in order. An empty list means no Skill is attached; nothing is inferred.

permissions.description: Explicit read-only permissions. Every field is fixed; there is no writable variant.

install.description: Must not install or write Skills into any agent's skill directory or configuration.

dispatch.description: Must not dispatch, send to, or control agents, runtimes, or managed work.

overwrite.description: Must not replace or modify an existing Skill's files or a runtime's current Skill selection.
